info.name: CRM Bulk Actions
info.description:
Bulk action platform API. Run `npm run db:seed` first so contacts 1..10000 exist, then create an action and use the Read / Logs requests (bulkActionId is filled in automatically after a create).

The file upload requests (CSV and XLSX) point at files in the project's data/ folder. In the Postman app, set Settings > General > Working directory to the project folder so it can find them, or pick the file again in the request's Body tab.

Creating actions is rate limited (CREATE_RATE_LIMIT_MAX per minute, 20 by default). Running the whole collection over and over in the same minute will start returning 429.

request.description: Queues a bulk update of 5,000 records as JSON (the JSON limit is 10,000; send bigger updates as a file). The first 10 rows show each outcome: row 4 points at a contact that doesn't exist, row 5 has a bad email and row 7 repeats row 2's email, so you get success, failed and skipped in one go. The other 4,990 rows update contacts 11 to 5,000 with a realistic mix of fields, and about 2% of them have a problem on purpose. Needs at least 5,000 seeded contacts (the default npm run db:seed gives 10,000).
